fee_label: fees_cents: 'fees on PayPal's record, equal to the sale's PayPal fee' (never 'chargeback fee'): the SELLER debits of reason DISPUTE_SETTLEMENT_FEE read from PayPal's record of each lost dispute (money_movements). Whether the seller is charged that fee a second time or the sale's fee is only marked as not returned is not settled yet; the report says only what the record lists. DIFF_with_fees uses them. fees_published_cents is PayPal Mexico's published chargeback fee per lost case (MXN 110.00 / USD 10.00, FEES.md (a), (a2), commit b52ed6f2), shown apart and never added to the recorded fee
